pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.meta: Setpoint for iPhone · Effective 18 November 2026 · Setpoint, Egypt

blocks.p: Setpoint is a food, nutrition and weight tracking app for iPhone. It is run by an individual based in Egypt under the name **Setpoint** ("we", "us"). We are the controller of the personal data described here.
Contact for anything about your data: [setpointapp.support@gmail.com](mailto:setpointapp.support@gmail.com).

list: Setpoint needs an account. What you log is kept on your iPhone and in your account, so it's safe if you change phones. We use it only to run the app for you.
Photo recognition, label reading, barcode scanning and "describe your meal" all happen **on your iPhone**. Your photos aren't sent anywhere to be analysed.
We don't show ads, don't use analytics or tracking, and don't sell or rent your data.
You can download everything (You → Back up, or You → Export to a spreadsheet) and delete your account and its data at any time (You → Account → Delete account).

blocks.p: **1. Your account.** Your email address and an account ID. If you sign in with Google, Google tells us your email address (and shares your name and profile picture with the sign-in service); Setpoint keeps only your email address and account ID. Passwords are handled by Google Firebase Authentication; we never see or store your password.

**2. What you enter in the app.** Your profile (sex, birth year, height and, if you add it, body fat), weigh-ins, food diary, your own foods, recipes and meals, water, fasting, body measurements, progress photos, notes, targets and settings. This is used to show your diary, targets, trends and insights, and to keep your data in your account.

**3. Health data.** Weight, food intake, body measurements and photos are health data, which the law treats as sensitive. We store it in your account only with your explicit consent, which you give when you create an account or sign in. You can withdraw that consent at any time by deleting your account.

**4. Apple Health.** Only if you turn it on (You → Settings → Apple Health): Setpoint reads your **weight** and **steps** from Apple Health to fill in your weigh-ins and estimate what you burn, and, if you choose "Save weigh-ins to Apple Health", saves your weigh-ins there. What it reads is treated like anything else you log (kept on your iPhone and in your account). Health data is never used for advertising or shared with anyone else. You can change what Setpoint may read or save at any time in the Health app.

**5. Camera and photos.** Used only when you choose to: scan a barcode, photograph a nutrition label or your plate, or add a progress photo. Barcodes, labels and food photos are read on your iPhone by Apple's built-in tools. A food photo isn't stored. Progress photos are kept on your iPhone and in your account.
**6. Describe your meal.** On iPhones with Apple Intelligence, you can type what you ate and the app splits it into foods. This uses Apple's on-device language model; your words stay on your iPhone.

**7. Food lookups.** When you scan a barcode that isn't in the app's own food list, the barcode number is sent to **Open Food Facts**, a public food database, to find the product. Like any online service, they can see your IP address. They don't receive your diary or account details.

**8. On your iPhone only.** Reminders, the app lock (Face ID or your passcode), widgets and the Lock Screen calories are handled by your iPhone. Face ID is checked by iOS; Setpoint never gets your face data.

We rely on your **explicit consent** for storing your health data in your account; on **providing the service you asked for** for your account and app features; and on our **legitimate interest** in keeping the app secure. This follows Egypt's Personal Data Protection Law (Law No. 151 of 2020) and, for people in the European Economic Area or the UK, the GDPR.

On your iPhone, in the app's own storage. In your account, with **Google Cloud Firestore** and **Firebase Authentication**, provided by Google, which act as our service providers (processors). Google's servers may be located outside Egypt, including in the United States and the European Union. By giving consent when you create an account or sign in, you agree to this transfer. Google protects data with encryption in transit and at rest, and our security rules let only you read or change your account's data.
The same account works in Setpoint on the web and in our Study Planner app.

list: Google (Firebase Authentication and Firestore), only to run your account. If you choose Google sign-in, Google also handles that sign-in.
Open Food Facts, only the barcodes you look up.
Authorities, only if the law requires it.

blocks.p: We never sell your data, and we don't share it with advertisers or data brokers.

list: On your iPhone: until you erase it (You → Settings → Erase all data on this iPhone) or delete the app.

In your account: until you delete your account. Deleting it removes your synced data and photos from our database straight away; Google may keep encrypted backups for a short time before they are overwritten. What's on your iPhone stays until you erase it.

blocks.p: You can ask to **see**, **correct**, **download** or **delete** your personal data, **withdraw consent**, or **object** to how it is used. Most of this you can do yourself in the app: edit anything you logged, download it all (You → Back up, or You → Export to a spreadsheet), and delete your account (You → Account → Delete account). For anything else, email [setpointapp.support@gmail.com](mailto:setpointapp.support@gmail.com) and we'll reply within 30 days.
If you're unhappy with how we handle your data, you can complain to Egypt's **Personal Data Protection Center**, or, in the EU/UK, to your local data protection authority.

Setpoint is not meant for children under 13, and we don't knowingly collect their data. Under Egyptian law anyone under 18 is a child: if you're under 18, you need a parent's or guardian's permission to create an account. If you believe a child has given us data without permission, contact us and we'll delete it.

Connections are encrypted, your account's data can only be read by you, and you can lock the app with Face ID or your passcode (You → Settings → Lock with Face ID). No system is perfectly secure, so please use a strong password and keep your iPhone locked.
If we change this policy we'll update the date at the top and, for important changes, tell you in the app. Using Setpoint after a change means you accept the updated policy.

pages.title: Terms of Use
pages.meta: Setpoint for iPhone · Effective 18 November 2026 · Setpoint, Egypt

blocks.p: These terms apply to your use of the Setpoint app for iPhone, run by an individual based in Egypt under the name Setpoint. By creating an account or using the app you agree to them. If you don't agree, please don't use Setpoint.

**Setpoint is a tracking tool, not a doctor.** Calorie and nutrient targets, burn estimates, refeeds, diet breaks, fasting timers and every other number in the app are general estimates based on formulas and what you log. They are not medical, nutritional or health advice and are not a diagnosis or treatment.

list: Talk to a doctor or registered dietitian before changing your diet, especially if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, under 18, have diabetes, heart, kidney or other medical conditions, take medication, or have or had an eating disorder.
Stop and get help if tracking makes you anxious or affects your eating in a harmful way.
In an emergency, contact your local emergency number straight away.

blocks.p: Food data comes from the US Department of Agriculture (FoodData Central), from Open Food Facts (a community database that anyone can edit), from estimates and from what you enter. Foods recognised from a photo or a description, and numbers read from a label, are the app's best guess. Any of it may contain mistakes or be out of date. Always check product labels, especially for **allergies** and intolerances. Brand and restaurant names are used only to identify foods; they belong to their owners, who are not connected with or endorsing Setpoint.
You must be 18 or older, or have permission from a parent or guardian. Setpoint is not for children under 13.

list: Setpoint needs an account. You're responsible for keeping your login details safe and for what happens in your account.
Your data belongs to you. You give us permission to store and process it only so we can run the app for you, as described in our [Privacy Policy](setpoint-legal://privacy).
If you connect Apple Health, what Setpoint reads from or saves to it is also covered by Apple's terms, and you can change that access at any time in the Health app.
You can delete your account at any time in the app (You → Account → Delete account).

blocks.p: Don't misuse Setpoint: no attempts to break into accounts or systems, overload the service, copy or resell the app or its food database, or use it for anything illegal.

The Setpoint app, its design and its code belong to Setpoint. You may use it for your own personal, non-commercial use. Parts of it come from others under their own licences: food data from USDA FoodData Central (public domain) and Open Food Facts (Open Database License); and the fonts Bricolage Grotesque, Figtree, IBM Plex Sans Arabic and Barlow Condensed (SIL Open Font License). Barcode scanning, label reading and photo recognition use Apple's built-in tools on your iPhone.

Setpoint is free today. If we add paid features, the price and what you get will be shown clearly before you pay, and our [Refund Policy](setpoint-legal://refunds) will apply. Nothing will ever be charged without you confirming it.

We may improve, change or stop parts of the app. We try to keep it running and your data safe, but we can't promise it will always be available or free of errors. You can keep your own copy at any time (You → Back up). We may suspend accounts that break these terms.

Setpoint is provided "as is". To the extent the law allows, we are not responsible for decisions you make based on the app, or for indirect losses. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have that the law doesn't allow us to limit, including your rights under Egypt's Consumer Protection Law (Law No. 181 of 2018).

These terms are governed by the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt. If you live in another country, you also keep any protections your local law gives you. If there's a disagreement, please contact us first at [setpointapp.support@gmail.com](mailto:setpointapp.support@gmail.com) so we can try to solve it.

**Setpoint itself doesn't set any cookies.** We don't use advertising, analytics or tracking cookies, or any other trackers, and we don't embed third-party content such as social media buttons or videos.
Because nothing optional is stored, we don't show a cookie consent banner: the law only requires consent for storage that isn't needed to provide what you asked for.

sections.heading: What the app stores on your device

list: **Local storage and IndexedDB**: your diary, weigh-ins, settings and photos, so the app works and keeps your data between visits. Strictly necessary.
**App cache** (service worker): a copy of the app and food database, so Setpoint opens fast and works offline. Strictly necessary.
**Sign-in**: if you sign in, Firebase Authentication keeps you signed in using your browser's storage. Strictly necessary.

blocks.p: If you choose "Continue with Google", Google's sign-in page may set its own cookies on Google's domain, under [Google's cookie policy](https://policies.google.com/technologies/cookies).
In the app: Settings → Erase all data. In your browser: clear site data for setpoint-tracker.web.app. If you clear it without a backup or an account, your data on that device is gone.
**Setpoint is free.** There are no purchases or subscriptions, so nothing can be charged and there's nothing to refund.
This policy will apply to any purchase made in Setpoint:

list: **14-day refund.** If you're not happy with a purchase, ask for a full refund within 14 days of buying it. No reason needed.
**Subscriptions.** You can cancel any time. You keep access until the end of the period you paid for, and you won't be charged again.
**Problems.** If a paid feature doesn't work as described and we can't fix it, we'll refund you, even after 14 days.
**App stores.** If you bought through the Apple App Store or Google Play, refunds go through them, under their rules; we'll help where we can.

blocks.p: To ask for a refund, email [setpointapp.support@gmail.com](mailto:setpointapp.support@gmail.com) with the email address on your account and the date of purchase. Refunds go back to the original payment method, normally within 14 days. This doesn't affect your rights under Egypt's Consumer Protection Law (Law No. 181 of 2018) or the law where you live.
